install_output_empty: Kunyina zyazwa pe. Mizila yamamanino kuzwa kuchibelesyo chakubikka iyooboneka aawa.
linux_setup_title: Linux Flashing & SP Flash Tool Setup
linux_setup_welcome: Kubamba SP Flash Tool ya Linux
linux_setup_welcome_desc: Kugwisya akubamba injini iifwambaana kumweka kuchitila kuti ukonzye kubweedezya akusumpula sikusobana wako kakunyina penzi.
linux_card_engine_desc: Chibelesyo cha MediaTek chakubelesya mumuni uuzwa mu laibbulali yanyika yoonse mbwiizulwa.
linux_card_usb_desc: Kupa nguzu zya desktop zyakubandika asikusobana munzila ya Bootloader.
system_checker_title: SP Flash Tool System Checker & Diagnostics
system_checker_desc: Kusinizya koonse kwama driver, ma kernel modules, zyeelelo, amalayibbulali aakubelesya muchiindi chakubeleka kuchitila kuti kube kumweka kubotu.
linux_prep_blocked: Eeyi kkompyuta taikonzyi kubelesya SP Flash Tool.
linux_prep_fix_body: Ntaamu yomwe yakusaanguna ichiyandikana: milawu ya USB yazibelesyo zya MediaTek akunjila kwa serial port.
linux_prep_fixed: Kuzumizigwa kwazumizigwa — SP Flash Tool ililibambilide.
settings_checker_desc: Ulibambila injini iimweka, mpawo ulalanga-langa kunjila kwa USB, tubunga twababelesi antoomwe ama modules aa kernel serial.
settings_driver_desc: Kotana ubelesya pulogilamu eeyi mchiindi chakusanguna, weelede kubikka MediaTek USB driver, mpawo ubweze kkompyuta yako.
home_desc: Yanduula pulogilamu ya firmware egubi naakuti usale pulogilamu yako, mpawo uyibike kuchibelesyo chako.
sel_source_desc: Kopolola pulogilamu ya firmware egubi, naakuti ubweze zyintu zyako.
settings_guided_install_desc: App eeyi ilakkala anduwe kwiinda mukuzima, kuswaanganya, akubika.
settings_sp_gui_install: Bika mu SP Flash Tool GUI
settings_sp_gui_desc: Kujala Updater CE mpawo kujalula SP Flash Tool GUI antoomwe a firmware scatter file alimwi azifwanikiso zya partition zyakabikkwa kale.
settings_terminal_desc: Chichita kubikka pulogilamu yako mu Terminal kuchitila kuti ubone makani aabusongo aatala akuyaambele.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Chichita kubikka pulogilamu yako mu Command Prompt kuchitila kuti ubone makani aabusongo aatala akuyaambele.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Chakulisalila. Zimwi zintu zya MediaTek zilakaka kumweka kusikila SP Flash Tool yapegwa fayela lyakusinizya (.auth); bika lyako aawa kuti chibelesyo chiyanda.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Kunyina fayela lyamwaika lyakajanika mubbokesi eeli, aboobo taakwe mulawu wa console wakakonzya kuyakwa.
terminal_install_no_tool: Taakwe SP Flash Tool build naa MTKClient entry point iiliko munzila eeyi.
terminal_install_failed: Tachikonzyi kujalula windo lya terminal. Mulawu wakubikka wakalembwa kuli {path}.
status_terminal_install: Mulawu wakubikka wakajalulwa muwindo lyako lyakubelesya ({nzila}).
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} lino ilajula kakuli {nzila}.

• Kuti kachitanazima, zima {chibelesyo} chako.
• Kuti yakajatikizyigwa a USB, kosaanguna kuchigwisya.
{hint}
• Swaanganya chibelesyo chako kukkompyuta yako aawo windo lya {terminal_name} nolyajulwa.

Dina OK kuti utalike akuzwa mu Updater CE.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Njiisyo: Kuti kachibelesyo kachitajatikizyi pe, tyanka bbatani lyakujokezya mubbokesi lyamapepa aawo noliswaanganya ntambo ya USB.
terminal_hint_generic: • Njiisyo: Kobikka chibelesyo chako muchiimo chakudonkola firmware (zilaandeene kweendelanya amusyobo: mbuli kuti gwisya bbattery mpawo ulibikke anze kakuli ntambo ya USB iijatikizyidwe, naa kuzima magesi kakuli bbattery ili mukati, naa kujatisya Volume Down/Up aawo noswaanganya USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Bikka kwiinda mu SP Flash Tool GUI
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI lino iyoojaluka aawo firmware yako niyakabikkwa kale.

• Mu SP Flash Tool, kkopa "Forma All + Download" kuzwa kubbokesi lizwa ansi.
• Tyanka bbatani lyakuti "Downlole".
• Bona kuti {chibelesyo} chako chilizimidwe akugwisigwa.
{hint}
• Swaanganya ntambo ya USB ku kkompyuta yako wamana kutyola Download.

Dina OK kuti utalike SP Flash Tool mpawo uzwe mu Updater CE.
settings_rockbox_desc: Zyakabelesegwa aawo notulanga zyintu zyakazwa mu Rockbox zya Y1.
settings_240p_tip: Chitondeezya ziyaka zili a ROM zip zili 240p (rom..._240p.zip). 240p zyakayakwa tazyeendelani a Y1 yuniti a Innioasis OS munsi a 3.0.7, aboobo Show Old Rockbox Builds zilazumizigwa anzizyo.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Kuzwa kwa Rockbox-Y1 kakutanaba 0.5 takubeleki antoomwe a Y1 yakasambalwa musule lya mwezi wa Nsondo 2026 Innioasis OS 3.0.7 yakabikkidwe kale.

Kubelesya zyintu zyakale zyakabambwa azibelesyo eezyi kuyoopa kuti kutabi kutalika.

Sena masimpe kuti uyanda kutondezya zintu zyakale zya Rockbox?
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Twalomba kuti usale .zip, .rar archive, naakuti scatter file (*scatter*.txt) mukati ka folda ya firmware kuti ubike firmware njosala a {target} yako.
sel_offline: Malembe aali a intaneti taaliwo pe lino. Belesya fayela lyamuunzi, naakuti langa kujatana kwako.
sel_multiple_scatters_error: Ma firmware miingi naakuti ma scatter files akajanwa mu folda/chiyobwedo eechi. Twalomba kuti usale fooloda naakuti busena bwakuyobweda zintu bujisi buyo firmware yomwe achiindi chomwe.
sp_auth_missing_file: Fayila yakusinizya tiiyakajanwa pe ({nzila}); kumweka kakunyina ncico.
sp_config_missing_platform: I fayela lya scatter talitondezyi nzila yalyo, aboobo bubambe bwa console bwa fayela lyakusinizya tabukonzyi kuyakwa pe; kumweka kakunyina ncico.
sp_config_missing_storage: I fayela lya scatter talyaambilizyi musyobo wakubamba (EMMC/NAND/UFS), aboobo bubambe bwa console bwa fayela lyakusinizya tiibwakali kukonzya kuyakwa pe; kumweka kakunyina ncico.
sp_config_no_auth_file: Taakwe fayela lyakusinizya lyakapegwa; kumweka kakunyina yomwe.
sp_config_write_failed: Tachikonzeka kulemba fayela lyakubamba zibelesyo; kumweka kakunyina fayela lyakusinizya.
settings_offline_mode_desc: Sisa bbuku lyamakani aabantu bali a intaneti mpawo ubike firmware kuzwa kuma fayila aali afwaafwi luzutu.
sel_themepack_prompt_body: Watondezya 360p Rockbox kuyaka. Sena inga wayanda kubikka 360p Theme Pack aachibelesyo eechi lino?
sel_themepack_guidance_title: Swaanganya sikusobana mu USB Storage Mode
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Twalomba kuti ugwisye USB, ujale manguzu mpawo ubweze Rockbox chiindi chomwe (mbuli kuti italisye .rockbox system folder), mpawo ubweze USB mpawo usale 'USB Storage Mode'.

Kuti waswaanganya, tyanka kuti uzumanane kusala folda iili yoonse aachipekupeku chako.
sel_themepack_select_folder: Sala chiyobwedo chilichose mubbokesi lyasikusobana wako uujatikizyidwe
sel_themepack_success: Rockbox Theme Pack yabikkwa kabotu aachibelesyo chako!
sel_only_local: Sala .zip naa .rar firmware yakubusena ooko kuti ukonzye kubikka kakunyina intaneti — kunyina intaneti iiyandika pe. Ibeleka a Innioasis a Timmkoo audio player yoonse.
sel_only_local_generic: Sala bbokesi lya firmware (.zip, .rar) naakuti fooloda ilijisi fayela lyakubelesya kakunyina intaneti — lilabeleka azibelesyo zya MediaTek.
sel_offline_install: Kobikka firmware kuzwa ku .zip naa .rar fayela kuli Innioasis naa Timmkoo audio player.
sel_offline_install_generic: Bikka firmware kuzwa ku .zip/.rar archive naakuti firmware folda kuzibelesyo zya MediaTek.
sel_update_available: Kuli zyintu zipya zya {software} ziliwo ku {model} yako.
sel_notes_hint: Sala zyakugwisya kuti ubone zyintu zyakachinchwa
flash_wait_desc: Kusaanguna kuzima chibelesyo eechi. Kuti naa yajatikizyigwa pesi tiiyakabonwa, eezya ntambo ya USB imbi naakuti port.
dialog_pre_install_header: Twalomba kuti ubone kuti {model} yako ilizwide magesi mpawo tiiyaswaangene a USB
dialog_pre_install_innioasis_tip:
• Zima manguzu woonse aachibelesyo chako kotana talika.
• Kuti chibelesyo chiliimvwi naakuti kachitabeleki, kobelesya pini naakuti chipepa muchibaka chakujokolosya kuchitila kuti magesi azwe muchiimo chakudonkola.
• Kobamba ntambo ya USB kuti itajatikizyidwe lino.
• Tyanka kuti Chiinkila kunembo, mpawo iswaanizya chibelesyo chako kwiinda mukubelesya USB kuti wabuzyigwa.
dialog_pre_install_generic_tip:
• Zima manguzu woonse aachibelesyo chako cha MediaTek.
• Kobamba ntambo ya USB kuti itajatikizyidwe lino.
• Kweelana amusyobo, ssola kuswaangana kakuli naa kakwiina bbattery (naakuti jatisya jwi lyaansi / mujulu aawo noli kuswaangana).
• Kotyola kuti uzumanane, mpawo ubike ntambo ya USB kuti wabuzyigwa.
flash_connect_prompt: Twalomba kuti ubone kuti {model} yako ilizimidwe mpawo tiikwe mpawo utyanke Next
flash_paperclip_hint: Njiisyo: Zima manguzu aachibelesyo eechi kwiinda mukusinikizya bbatani lisisidwe kumbali aachibikkilo chamafooni aamatwi aapepa naakuti pini.
flash_paperclip_hint_a5: Njiisyo: Zima manguzu aachibelesyo kwiinda mukusinikizya bbatani lisisidwe afwaafwi abbatani lyamagesi aapepa naakuti pini.
gui_handoff_hint_headphone: Zima magesi kwiinda mukubikka pini naa kkilipi mumpako iili afwaafwi abusena bwakubikkila mafooni, mpawo ubike USB aawo chibelesyo cha desktop nichilindila.
gui_handoff_hint_a5: Kobikka pini naakuti kkilipi mumpako munsi lya bbatani lyamagesi, mpawo ubike USB aawo chibelesyo cha desktop nichilindila.
gui_handoff_hint_generic: Zima chibelesyo, gwisya USB, mpawo uchijate aawo chibelesyo nichilomba.
gui_handoff_hint_generic_mediatek: Zima manguzu aachibelesyo, gwisya USB, mpawo uchijate aawo chibelesyo nichikumbila firmware.
gui_handoff_failed: Chibelesyo cha desktop tiichakakonzya kujulwa pe.
flash_preparing: Kulibambila bbokesi lya firmware... Kobamba chibelesyo eechi kachitakwe magesi kwachiindi eechi.
flash_searching: Kuyandaula chibelesyo chako... Lino zima chibelesyo eecho mpawo uchijate ntambo ya USB.
flash_guide_1: 1. Zima manguzu aachibelesyo (belesya pini naakuti chipepa muchibaka chakujokolosya kuti kwayandika)
flash_guide_2: 2. Swaanganya kwiinda mukubelesya ntambo ya USB
flash_warning: Utagwisyi magesi, ntambo ya USB, naa kujala chibelesyo.
flash_method_note_auto: Auto: SP Flash Tool a Windows a Linux, MTKClient a macOS. Ulakonzya kuchincha omwini aapulatifomu iili yoonse.
flash_method_note_sp: SP Flash Tool — MediaTek's official flasher. Ku Linux kuyaka kwabantu boonse kulagwisigwa mpawo kwabikkwa aawo mpokusaanguna kubelesegwa.
sp_gui_launch_intro:
SP Flash Tool GUI lino ilatalika.

• Kuti tiikwazima, zima chibelesyo chako.
• Kuti yakajatikizyigwa a USB, kosaanguna kuchigwisya.
• Mu SP Flash Tool, tyanka Kopolola (naa Kubamba Zyoonse + Kopolola mbuli mbokuyandika).

Mpawo jata ntambo ya USB kuti utalike kumweka.
sp_gui_not_supported: SP Flash Tool GUI ilajanika buyo a Windows antoomwe a Linux (x86/x86_64) systems.
sp_gui_error_desc: Kwaalilwa kutalisya SP Flash Tool GUI:
sp_gui_no_cached_firmware: Kunyina bbokesi lya firmware lyakavwumbidwe kuzwa mukusola kubikka kwakaindi lyakajanika, naakuti zifwanikiso zyakwaandaanya ziyandika taziko pe. Twalomba kuti usale naa kudonwula pulogilamu yakamwaigwa katana jula SP Flash Tool.
flash_cancel_msg: Nzila ya flash ili mukuchitika lino. Sena uyanda kuchileka mpawo utalike chipya?
flash_close_confirm: Sena uli masimpe kuti uyanda kuleka kubikka akujala {app}?
log_session_tip: Koya ku log yakusola kubikka kwakalekkoodwa
drop_firmware_here: Bika fayela lya firmware aawa kuti libikke
drop_missing_scatter: Kunyina fayela lyamwaika lyakajanwa, aboobo kubikka tiikwakatalika pe.
drop_missing_images: Zimwi zifwanikiso zilembedwe mufailo lya scatter taziliwo pe, aboobo kubikka tiikwakatalika pe.
donate_subtitle: milimu yesu iyeeme akusanga kuzwa kubantu bamuchilawu
donate_intro_success_mediatek:
Twabikka {software} a {model} yako.

Hei! Ndime Ryan, sikubamba MediaTek Installer. Ndilavwola mali yakubamba akubamba zintu kuzwa munkomo yangu kuchitila kuti chibelesyo eechi chizumanane kakunyina kubbadelesya. Kuti chakugwasya, ndakulomba kuti uyeeye kusanga — chipa kuti mulimo ooyu uzumanane kupona kuliboonse.
donate_intro_general_mediatek: Iwe! Ndime Ryan, sikubamba MediaTek Installer. Ndilabbadelela kubamba, zibelesyo akubamba zintu kuzwa munkomo yangu ndemwini kuchitila kuti installer eeyi ibe yabuyo. Kubamba mwezi amwezi kusika ku $200 — lugwasyo luli loonse ndomupa lulagwasya kuti chizumanane kupona kuli yooyo uutobela.
donate_intro_success:
Twabikka {software} a {model} yako.

Hei! Ndime Ryan, sikubamba zintu zya Updater CE, Community Firmware Archive, antoomwe a Themes Gallery. Ndilavwola ~$200 amwezi amali aabelesyegwa kuseva akubamba zintu kuzwa munkomo yangu kuchitila kuti zyoonse zizumanane kakunyina kubbadalwa. Kuti eechi chibelesyo chakugwasya, koyeeya kusanga — chipa kuti zintu eezyi kazipona kumuntu uli oonse.
donate_intro_general: Iwe! Ndime Ryan, sikubamba zintu zya Updater CE, Community Firmware Archive, antoomwe a Themes Gallery. Ndilabbadelela kubamba seva, kubamba zintu zya firmware, akubambulula domain kuzwa munkomo yangu kutegwa zyoonse kazitabbadelwi. Kubamba mwezi amwezi kusika ku $200 — lugwasyo luli loonse ndomupa lulagwasya kuti zibelesyo eezyi kazipona kuli yooyo uutobela.

donate_thanks: Twalumba kuli basikugwasyilizya besu boonse abasikugwasizya!
donate_coffee_pitch: Wapona, Ryan aawa, kuti wajana kuti chibelesyo changu {app} chilagwasya, ulakonzya kundiulila kkofi.

settings_reminders_desc: Sikubambulula Neo ulayeeya kuti ncibeela nzi cha firmware chakabikkidwe kuma Innioasis players aako, akuchenjezya aawo zipya nozizwa.

reminder_prompt_install: Sena inga wayanda kutalika kubikka (anzila njoosala: {nzila})?

retry_guidance_step_1: 1. Gwisya ntambo ya USB kuzwa kuchibelesyo chako.

log_install_writing: Bikka muchiindi - kulemba zifwanikiso zya firmware...
log_sparse_fmt: Twakajana chifanikisyo chiche cha Android cha {cibeela}, kusandula muchiimo...
themepack_card_desc: Zibikkilizya mitwe yamakani mibotu yabantu, zifwanikiso zyakumbele ziboneka kabotu, amabala aakabambilwa zitondezyo zya 360p.
themepack_step1_title: Ntaamu 1: Swaanganya mu USB Storage Mode
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Jula chibelesyo chako kwiinda mukujatisya bbatani lya Power.
2. Eelyo Rockbox niyatalika, bikka ntambo ya USB mukkompyuta yako.
3. Kuti wabuzyigwa aachipekupeku, sinizya nzila yakubamba USB kuchitila kuti chibelesyo chiboneke mbuli ntambo.
themepack_step2_title: Ntaamu yabili: Sala fooloda iili yoonse aachipekupeku
themepack_step2_desc: Nkaambo kakuti nzila zyakubelesya (mbuli macOS) zilasisa ma dotfile (mbuli .rockbox) mbuli mbozibede, ulakonzya kusala folda iili yoonse naakuti drive root a player yako. Tulakujana naa kukupangila .rockbox directory.
themepack_complete: Ibbokesi lyamutwe wamakani lyakabikkwa kabotu! Lino ulakonzya kugwisya chibelesyo chako kakunyina ntenda mpawo usale mutwe wamakani mu Rockbox (Zyakubamba > Zyakubamba zyamutwe wamakani).
themepack_err_not_found: Tachikonzeka pe kujana naa kutalisya .rockbox directory a drive yasalwa. Kosinizya kuti wasala fooloda aachibelesyo chako.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Ntaamu 1: Talika alimwi sikusobana mpawo ubwezelezye
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Gwisya ntambo ya USB.
2. Bikka nguzu zyakusobana mpawo uzileke kuti zitalike kunjila mu Rockbox.
3. Ikuti Rockbox yatalika kubeleka, swaanizya ntambo ya USB, mpawo utyanke Kuzumanana.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Ntaamu yabili: Kuyandaula sikusobana kwiinda ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: App eeyi ilikulangisisya kuti naa kuli kujatana kwa ADB (kusikila kumasekondi aali 30). Kuti chibelesyo chajanwa, mitwe yamakani ilacincwa mpawo sikusobana ulatalika lubo. Naa pe, koya kunembo kuya ku USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: Kulindila chintu cha ADB... (kusikila kumasekondi aali 30)
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Taakwe chintu cha ADB chakajanika mukati kamasekondi aali 30; kuzumanana a USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Taakwe ADB binary iijanika mu app; kuzumanana a USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Kusungilizya mitwe yamakani amabala aa ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Kutumina kwa ADB kwaalilwa; kujokela ku USB Storage Mode
rockbox_wizard_usb_title: Bikka kwiinda mukubelesya nzila yakubamba ya USB
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Bikka nzila yakubamba USB aachipekupeku kuchitila kuti iboneke mbuli ntambo.
2. Sala fooloda iili yoonse aachipekupeku chili munsi (.rockbox, Nyimbo, Mitwe, naakuti muyanda wa drive — fooloda ya .rockbox iisisidwe ilajanika biyo).
3. App eeyi ilaswaanganya mitwe yamakani a 360p amabala, akulemba ma fayela aamazina aakozyenye.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Lino ulakonzya kugwisya chisobano kakunyina ntenda mpawo usale mutwe wamakani mu Rockbox (Mabambe > Mabambe amutwe wamakani).
legacy_cleanup_desc: Musyobo wakaindi wa Updater uchili aakkompyuta eeyi mpawo utola busena bupati. Kuchigwisya kulagwisya busena oobo.
legacy_cleanup_reclaim: Kubweedezya busena buli afwaafwi a {bupati} bwa disiki
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Gwisya pulogilamu yakaindi ya Innioasis Updater antoomwe amafooloda aagwasya
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Bikka zibelesyo zya Android (ADB / Fastboot) kazibikkidwe
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: Kuti kotabelesyi ADB naa Fastboot kunze lya Updater CE, kogwisya chikozyano kuti ugwisye mpawo ubweze busena bwakuyobweda.
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: Wakazwidilila kusalazya zyintu zyakale mpawo wakabweza busena bwadisiki.
legacy_cleanup_card_desc: Musyobo wakaindi wa Updater uchili aakkompyuta eeyi. Kuchigwisya kupa kuti kube busena bwadisiki.
legacy_cleanup_confirm_body: Eezi zigwisya pulogilamu yakaindi antoomwe amafayela aayo aagwasya. Firmware yakagwisigwa ilabikkwa.
legacy_cleanup_tools_body: Kugwisya zibelesyo zya Android (ADB / Fastboot) azyalo? Sala kubamba kuti kobelesya ADB.
